plan.objective: Run Windows 3.11 for Workgroups from /app/isos/win311.img in QEMU with snapshot mode, VNC on :1 (5901), nginx on port 80, and a programmatic keyboard input path, leaving the VM running in the background at the Windows 3.11 desktop.
evidence: Need receipt-backed evidence of QEMU launch command and running process
Need receipt-backed evidence of VNC listener on 127.0.0.1:5901
Need receipt-backed evidence of nginx listener on port 80
Need receipt-backed evidence of programmatic keyboard input path configured or exercised
Need receipt-backed evidence VM reached Windows 3.11 desktop or equivalent boot-complete state
plan.current_focus: Inspect existing workspace for any launch scripts/configs or prior receipts, then start or adapt QEMU and nginx with verifiable listeners.
implementation_approach: Use existing receipts before repeating equivalent inspection
Launch QEMU in snapshot mode against /app/isos/win311.img with VNC :1 and a monitor/control channel suitable for programmatic keyboard injection
Start nginx on port 80 with a simple web interface if needed
Keep QEMU running in background and verify listeners/process state
Use monitor or another external control path to demonstrate keyboard injection capability
Confirm boot-complete/desktop state via VNC or logs
validation_strategy: Process listing for QEMU with the exact image and snapshot/VNC options
Evidence of keyboard injection path via QEMU monitor or equivalent
Evidence of Windows 3.11 desktop reached, not just VM started
verification_test_strategy: Prefer receipt-backed runtime checks over file existence
Avoid repeating equivalent checks unless state changes
If a prerequisite is missing, repair configuration and re-verify
known_bad_behavior: Checks that only prove binaries exist or commands parse
evidence_gaps: No current evidence of running QEMU
No current evidence of VNC listener
No current evidence of nginx listener
No current evidence of keyboard injection path
No current evidence of desktop state
risks: QEMU or nginx may not be installed
Windows boot may take time or require interaction
Need to preserve immutable snapshot mode while still enabling control
next_steps: Inspect prior receipts and workspace for existing launch artifacts
